summary: Remote-controlled PTY/child-process execution driven by a hardcoded Supabase backend
details: The package runs a daemon that polls a hardcoded Supabase project (syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) for `runtime_commands` and `runtime_requests` and executes them on the installer's host. In dist/session-runner.js, remote-supplied input is fed into a PTY spawned via node-pty (`child.write(code + '\r')`, `child.stdin.write(key + '\n')`) and drives local AI-agent CLIs (claude/codex/gemini/kimi/grok). Remote commands also trigger `npm install -g <harness>` and daemon self-update/restart, giving the paired backend arbitrary command execution and package-install capability on the host. In dist/capabilities.js, a 30s heartbeat enumerates local AI-tool credential/config files under the user's home (`~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json`, `~/.grok/auth.json`, `~/.kimi-code/credentials/*.json`, `~/.gemini/.env`, `~/.kimi/config`) and posts extracted account metadata (login state, email, plan, versions) to the same Supabase project. The remote command channel and self-update path are reachable whenever the daemon is running, regardless of who issues the `runtime_command` on the backend side.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
